chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Wāsiṭī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“Indeed, Ibrāhīm, the intimate friend of al-Raḥmān, asked his Lord to provide him with a daughter who would weep for him after his death.”

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Ibrāhīm عليه السلام, the Prophet being mentioned in the report
key_terms.خَلِيلَ: intimate friend; one brought into special closeness

ai.seo_question: Why did Ibrāhīm عليه السلام ask Allah for a daughter to weep for him after his death?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Ibrāhīm عليه السلام asked Allah to grant him a daughter who would mourn him after his death. It highlights the human need for familial affection and remembrance at death, and reflects the role of kinship in honoring the deceased.
